title: Biology-informed modelling
description: Identifiability of the ultradian glucose-insulin model before fitting (exact forward sensitivities), nonlinear PK/PD design and inference, Aliev-Panfilov activation maps recovered by an eikonal PINN, and the library aorta with Windkessel outlets in OpenFOAM.

metrics.name: fisher_smallest_over_largest_eigenvalue
metrics.how: ultradian model, G at 361 random minutes, 1 % noise, 17 parameters (identifiability_ultradian.py)

metrics.name: fisher_null_vector_C2_component
metrics.how: eigenvector of the smallest Fisher eigenvalue

metrics.name: invariance_U0_Um_C3_eigenvalue_ratio
metrics.how: Fisher matrix restricted to U0, Um, C3

metrics.name: activation_rmse_eikonal_pinn
metrics.how: 64 sites, Aliev-Panfilov reference at dx 0.25, all conducting grid points

metrics.name: cv_median_rel_error_eikonal_pinn
metrics.how: conduction velocity from the PINN map, >4 units from the scar

metrics.name: activation_grid_check_rms
metrics.how: activation map dx 0.5 vs dx 0.25 at common nodes

metrics.name: pkpd_coverage_95_min
metrics.how: fraction of 20 noise draws whose 95 % credible interval (adaptive Metropolis, 3000 steps) contains the true value; Vmax 0.90, Km 0.95, V 1.00, ka 0.95

metrics.name: pkpd_median_abs_rel_error_max
metrics.how: posterior medians over 20 draws, worst of Vmax, Km, V, ka (Km)

metrics.name: pbpk_auc_rel_error
metrics.how: AUC of arterial plasma against dose / (CL_ws + CLr), 300 h

metrics.name: aorta_flow_fraction_max_rel_error_vs_0d
metrics.how: reduced-scale (2 of 4 cycles): cycle-mean outlet flow fractions against the 0-D resistance split, worst outlet

metrics.name: aorta_mass_imbalance
metrics.how: max |sum Q_out - Q_in| over the second cycle / cycle-mean inflow

metrics.name: aorta_systolic_mmHg
metrics.how: reduced-scale (2 of 4 cycles), inlet, second cycle; not periodic yet (cycle-mean 106.4 then 100.3 mmHg, 0-D mean 93)
